rationale: Score/risk thresholds SeverityClassifier uses to bucket a subsystem into CRITICAL/DEGRADED/WATCH/NORMAL. Same values the code shipped with before this file existed -- moving them here does not change classification output, it only makes them reviewable and revisable without recompiling. Round numbers (80/50/20 on a 0-100 score, 0.8/0.5/0.2 on a 0-1 risk estimate) are placeholders expressing 'roughly top/middle/bottom third', NOT fitted against real fleet outcome data. Revisit once GoMechanic domain review or real failure/repair outcomes are available.
